segments.title: Penguins live in Africa!
segments.say: Penguins live in Africa! Meet them with Thabo from Cape Town.

segments.title: Where is this beach?
segments.say: Where is their sunny beach? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Here since 1983!
segments.say: Penguins have lived on this beach since nineteen eighty-three.

segments.title: Look, don't touch!
segments.say: Big rocks calm the waves. Their beaks are sharp, so we just watch.
